repairs.before: Yao Hong replied: "Titles exist to reward future service and mark true virtue.
repairs.after: Yao Hong replied, “The court holds out titles to admonish and encourage those who will render service and to give public recognition to outstanding virtue.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓曰：「懸爵於朝，所以懲勸來效，標明盛德。
repairs.sourceReason: 懲勸 expresses both admonition and encouragement of future service.

repairs.before: I share every grief with my household staff—how could I hoard favors for myself alone?"
repairs.after: I, Yuanzi, have seen my house struck by misfortune. My palace officers shared all these troubles with me. Could I enjoy the good fortune alone without feeling ashamed?”
repairs.sourceWitness: 元子遭家不造，與宮臣同此百憂，獨享其福，得不愧於心乎！」
repairs.sourceReason: 遭家不造 specifies Hong’s family calamity, and Yuanzi is Hong’s self-designation.

repairs.before: Yao Shao urged delay: "Reward them, yes, but wait until spring as the ancients would."
repairs.after: Yao Shao stepped forward. “Your Majesty remembers to reward virtue, and you are right to grant them fiefs. In antiquity people treated such matters with reverence, timing the appointments for the beginning of the year. You could wait until next spring and then deliberate.”
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹進曰：「陛下不忘報德，封之是也，古者敬其事，命之以始，可須來春，然後議之。」
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Shao’s expressed approval of repaying virtue, the ancient practice of attending to the beginning, and his proposal to deliberate next spring.

repairs.before: Tens of thousands of Hu households in Bing, Dingyang, and Ercheng rose against Yao Hong, entered Pingyang, attacked Liyi Yao Chengdu at the Xiongnu fort, raised the Xiongnu Cao Hong as great shanyu, and wherever they went ravaged and plundered.
repairs.after: Several tens of thousands of Hu households from Bingzhou, Dingyang and Ercheng rebelled against Hong. They entered Pingyang, attacked General Yao Chengdu, who held the title Liyi, at the Xiongnu fort, and proclaimed Cao Hong of the Xiongnu grand shanyu. Everywhere they went they ravaged and plundered.
repairs.sourceWitness: 并州、定陽、貳城胡數萬落叛泓，入於平陽，攻立義姚成都於匈奴堡，推匈奴曹弘為大單于，所在殘掠。
repairs.sourceReason: 立義 is an abbreviated general’s title, and 落 counts tribal households or encampments, not tens of thousands of settlements.

repairs.after: Yao Yi, General Who Conquers the East, marched from Puban against Cao Hong, routed him at Pingyang, captured him and sent him to Chang’an. Yi resettled fifteen thousand leading households in Yongzhou.
repairs.sourceWitness: 征東姚懿自蒲阪討弘，戰於平陽，大破之，執弘，送于長安，徙其豪右萬五千落於雍州。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Yi’s title and the seizure of Cao Hong before he was sent away.

repairs.before: General Who Conquers the East Yao Yi from Puban campaigned against Cao Hong, fought at Pingyang, greatly defeated him, seized Cao Hong, sent him to Chang'an, and moved fifteen thousand notable settlements to Yongzhou.
repairs.after: General Who Conquers the East Yao Yi set out from Puban against Cao Hong. He fought at Pingyang, routed Hong, captured him and sent him to Chang’an. He transferred fifteen thousand of their leading households to Yongzhou.
repairs.sourceWitness: 征東姚懿自蒲阪討弘，戰於平陽，大破之，執弘，送于長安，徙其豪右萬五千落於雍州。
repairs.sourceReason: 落 counts households or tribal encampments here; the translation inflates their settlement count.

repairs.before: Yang Sheng of Chouqi seized Qishan, captured Wang Zong, and drove on Qinzhou.

repairs.before: Duke of Chouqi Yang Sheng attacked and took Qishan, seized Jianjie Wang Zong, then pressed Qinzhou.
repairs.after: Yang Sheng, Duke of Chouchi, stormed Qishan, captured General Wang Zong, who held the title Jianjie, and pressed on toward Qinzhou.

repairs.after: Yao Song and Yao Ping pursued Yang Sheng and caught up with him at Bamboo Ridge. Yao Zan hurried to their aid with Yao Qindu, governor of Longxi, Wang Huan, governor of Lüeyang, and the palace guards.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚嵩與平追盛及於竹嶺，姚贊率隴西太守姚秦都、略陽太守王煥以禁兵赴之。
repairs.sourceReason: 及 means actually catching up with Sheng, and the two 太守 are governors of the named commanderies; 禁兵 are palace guards.

repairs.after: Yao Song and Yao Ping pursued Yang Sheng and caught up with him at Bamboo Ridge. Yao Zan hurried to their aid with Yao Qindu, governor of Longxi, Wang Huan, governor of Lüeyang, and the palace guards.

repairs.before: Earlier a stone drum in Jixian boomed for hundreds of li and pheasants called without cease.

repairs.sourceWitness: 先是，天水冀縣石鼓鳴，聲聞數百里，野雉皆雊。
repairs.sourceReason: The drum was in Ji county of Tianshui, and 皆 means all the pheasants, not uninterrupted calling.

repairs.before: Qinzhou then suffered dozens of quakes, rockslides, and ruined homes—everyone called it an ill omen.
repairs.after: Qinzhou suffered thirty-two earthquakes, eight accompanied by rumbling. Mountains collapsed and houses fell. Everyone took these as ill omens.
repairs.sourceWitness: 秦州地震者三十二，殷殷有聲者八，山崩舍壞，咸以為不祥。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore both numbers: thirty-two earthquakes and eight audible rumbles.

repairs.before: Wise men said Qinzhou was Yao Hong's home ground—its ruin foretold his own.
repairs.after: Those who understood the signs thought that, because Qinzhou was Yao Hong’s native place, they foretold his impending downfall.

repairs.sourceReason: The omens concern Hong’s approaching fall because Qinzhou was his home region; the text does not report Qinzhou destroyed.

repairs.after: Hu Yan killed the generals Mijie Cheng and Pei Qi, holders of the titles Lijie and Jianwu respectively. Yao Chen, General Who Guards the West, abandoned his garrison and fled east.
repairs.sourceWitness: 立節彌姐成、建武裴岐為儼所殺，鎮西姚諶委鎮東走。
repairs.sourceReason: Yan killed the holders of two military titles; dying in battle is unspecified. Chen held the General Who Guards the West title.

repairs.before: Yao Shao, Yin Zhao, and Yao Qia led fifty thousand men against Bobo; Yao Hui followed with ten thousand horse.
repairs.after: Yao Shao, General Who Campaigns against the Enemy Yin Zhao, General Who Guards the Army Yao Qia and others led fifty thousand infantry and cavalry against Bobo. Yao Hui followed with ten thousand picked cavalry.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹及征虜尹昭、鎮軍姚洽等率步騎五萬討勃勃，姚恢以精騎一萬繼之。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore two military titles, the mixed infantry and cavalry force, and the picked cavalry following them.

repairs.before: At Hengshui Bobo pulled back to Anding; Hu Yan shut the gates, killed thousands of Xianbei, and handed the city over.
repairs.after: Shao’s army halted at Hengshui. Bobo fell back toward Anding to hold it, but Hu Yan shut the gates against him, killed several thousand Xianbei and surrendered the city.
repairs.sourceWitness: 軍次橫水，勃勃退保安定，胡儼閉門距之，殺鮮卑數千人，據安定以降。
repairs.sourceReason: It is Shao’s army that camps at Hengshui. Bobo’s separate withdrawal was blocked at Anding.

repairs.before: Yao Shao beat Bobo at Ma'an Ridge, chased him toward Zhaona, then broke off the pursuit.
repairs.after: Yao Shao pressed after Bobo, defeated him at Ma’an Slope and pursued him as far as Chaona. Unable to overtake him, Shao returned.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹進兵躡勃勃，戰於馬鞍阪，敗之，追至朝那，不及而還。
repairs.sourceReason: The pursuit reached 朝那; Shao returned because he failed to catch Bobo.

repairs.before: Shao advanced the army to tread on Bobo, fought at Ma'an Slope, defeated him, pursued to Zhaona, did not catch up and returned.
repairs.after: Yao Shao pressed after Bobo, defeated him at Ma’an Slope and pursued him as far as Chaona. Unable to overtake him, Shao returned.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹進兵躡勃勃，戰於馬鞍阪，敗之，追至朝那，不及而還。
repairs.sourceReason: The pursuit reached 朝那; Shao returned because he failed to catch Bobo.

repairs.before: Yang Sheng sent his nephew Yang Juan against Changshe.
repairs.after: Yang Sheng sent Yang Juan, his elder brother’s son, to invade Changshe.
repairs.sourceWitness: 楊盛遣兄子倦入寇長蛇。
repairs.sourceReason: 兄子 specifies the son of Sheng’s elder brother.

repairs.before: The Di chief Gou Ke seized Wuzhangyuan; Yao Wan and Yao Nan marched against him and lost.
repairs.after: Gou Ke, a Di man of Pingyang, gathered more than a thousand men and occupied Wuzhangyuan in revolt. Yao Hong sent Yao Wan, General Who Guards the Distant Lands, and Yao Nan, General Who Restores Might, against him. Gou Ke defeated them.
repairs.sourceWitness: 平陽氐苟渴聚眾千餘，據五丈原以叛，遣鎮遠姚萬、恢武姚難討之，為渴所敗。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Ke’s Pingyang affiliation, force of over a thousand, explicit rebellion and the two generals’ titles. No chieftaincy is stated.

repairs.before: Yao Hong sent Lian Mankui and Yao Guang'er to Chencang; Yang Juan bolted for Sanguan.
repairs.after: Hong sent Lian Manwei, General Who Supports the State, and Forward General Yao Guang’er to attack Yang Juan at Chencang. Juan fled to San Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓使輔國斂曼嵬、前將軍姚光兒討楊倦于陳倉，倦奔于散關。
repairs.sourceReason: 嵬 is Wei in Manwei; both commanders have titles, and their mission was to attack Juan.

repairs.before: Hong sent General Who Supports the State Lian Mankui and Forward General Yao Guang'er to campaign against Yang Juan at Chencang; Juan fled to Sanguan.
repairs.after: Hong sent Lian Manwei, General Who Supports the State, and Forward General Yao Guang’er to attack Yang Juan at Chencang. Juan fled to San Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓使輔國斂曼嵬、前將軍姚光兒討楊倦于陳倉，倦奔于散關。
repairs.sourceReason: 嵬 is Wei in Manwei; both commanders have titles, and their mission was to attack Juan.

repairs.before: Bobo's nephew Ti raided Chiyang but Yao Yu, Peng Bailang, and She Xuan threw him back.
repairs.after: Bobo sent Ti, his elder brother’s son, south to invade Chiyang. Yao Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Forward General Peng Bailang, and General She Xuan, who held the title Jianyi, met his attack and drove him back.
repairs.sourceWitness: 勃勃遣兄子提南侵池陽，車騎姚裕、前將軍彭白狼、建義蛇玄距卻之。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the elder brother’s son, the southward raid and all three officers’ roles; 車騎 denotes a general’s title.

repairs.before: Bobo sent his elder brother's son Ti south to raid Chiyang; chariots and cavalry Yao Yu, Forward General Peng Bailang, and Jianyi She Xuan blocked him and drove him back.
repairs.after: Bobo sent Ti, his elder brother’s son, south to invade Chiyang. Yao Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Forward General Peng Bailang, and General She Xuan, who held the title Jianyi, met his attack and drove him back.
repairs.sourceWitness: 勃勃遣兄子提南侵池陽，車騎姚裕、前將軍彭白狼、建義蛇玄距卻之。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the elder brother’s son, the southward raid and all three officers’ roles; 車騎 denotes a general’s title.

repairs.before: Soon Liu Yu of Jin massed at Pengcheng and sent Tan Daoji and Wang Zhen'e through Huai-Fei against Qiqiu and Xiangcheng while Shen Linzi struck Cangyuan from Bian.
repairs.after: Soon afterward Jin’s grand commandant Liu Yu led a great army against Yao Hong and halted at Pengcheng. He sent Champion General Tan Daoji and Dragon-Soaring General Wang Zhen’e in by the Huai and Fei rivers to attack Qiqiu and Xiangcheng. General Shen Linzi entered the Yellow River from the Bian and attacked Cangyuan.
repairs.sourceWitness: 尋而晉太尉劉裕總大軍伐泓，次於彭城，遣冠軍將軍檀道濟、龍驤將軍王鎮惡入自淮、肥，攻漆丘、項城，將軍沈林子自汴入河，攻倉垣。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Liu Yu’s grand commandant office, his campaign against Hong, his officers’ military titles and Shen Linzi’s route from the Bian into the Yellow River.

repairs.before: Wang Gousheng yielded Qiqiu to Wang Zhen'e, Yao Zhang yielded Xiangcheng to Tan Daoji, and the Jin host poured through Yingkou almost unopposed.
repairs.after: Hong’s general Wang Gousheng surrendered Qiqiu to Wang Zhen’e, and Yao Zhang, inspector of Xuzhou, surrendered Xiangcheng to Tan Daoji. The Jin army then entered Yingkou, and many places submitted as it advanced.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓將王苟生以漆丘降鎮惡，徐州刺史姚掌以項城降道濟，王師遂入潁口，所至多降服。
repairs.sourceReason: 多 qualifies submissions: many places submitted. The first officer is Hong’s general and the second inspector of Xuzhou.

repairs.before: Hong's general Wang Gousheng surrendered Qiqiu to Zhen'e; Xuzhou Inspector Yao Zhang surrendered Xiangcheng to Daoji; the royal army then entered Yingkou, and wherever it went there was surrender.
repairs.after: Hong’s general Wang Gousheng surrendered Qiqiu to Wang Zhen’e, and Yao Zhang, inspector of Xuzhou, surrendered Xiangcheng to Tan Daoji. The Jin army then entered Yingkou, and many places submitted as it advanced.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓將王苟生以漆丘降鎮惡，徐州刺史姚掌以項城降道濟，王師遂入潁口，所至多降服。
repairs.sourceReason: 多 qualifies submissions: many places submitted. The first officer is Hong’s general and the second inspector of Xuzhou.

repairs.before: Only Dong Zun of Xin'cai held out until Tan Daoji stormed the city and bound him before the camp.
repairs.after: Only Dong Zun, governor of Xincai, held firm and refused to surrender. Tan Daoji stormed the place, had Zun bound and brought him to the gate of the camp.
repairs.sourceWitness: 惟新蔡太守董遵固守不降，道濟攻破之，縛遵而致諸軍門。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Dong’s governorship and being brought bound to the camp gate.

repairs.before: Dong Zun snapped: "Ancient kings campaigned with courtesy toward worthy foes.
repairs.after: With a stern expression Dong Zun said, “When kings of old made war on other states, they treated men of worth with courtesy.
repairs.sourceWitness: 遵厲色曰：「古之王者伐國，待士以禮。
repairs.sourceReason: 士 means men of standing or worth here; neither enemies specifically nor knights as a military class.

repairs.before: Zun in stern color said, "Kings of old in campaigning against states treated knights with ritual.
repairs.after: With a stern expression Dong Zun said, “When kings of old made war on other states, they treated men of worth with courtesy.
repairs.sourceWitness: 遵厲色曰：「古之王者伐國，待士以禮。
repairs.sourceReason: 士 means men of standing or worth here; neither enemies specifically nor knights as a military class.

repairs.before: How dare you wage an unjust war and dishonor a loyal governor?"
repairs.after: How can you wage war unjustly and treat a man of distinction in another state with such discourtesy?”
repairs.sourceWitness: 君奈何以不義行師，待國土以非禮乎。」
repairs.sourceReason: The sealed text’s 土 is at odds with 士 in a Jinshu witness and the preceding 待士以禮. The parallel supports 國士, a man of distinction in the state, without restricting this to a loyal governor. See https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/WUL-bunko11_d0271_%E6%99%8B%E6%9B%B8_18.pdf .

repairs.before: How can you, sir, march with unrighteous conduct and treat a state's knights without ritual."
repairs.after: How can you wage war unjustly and treat a man of distinction in another state with such discourtesy?”
repairs.sourceWitness: 君奈何以不義行師，待國土以非禮乎。」
repairs.sourceReason: The sealed text’s 土 is at odds with 士 in a Jinshu witness and the preceding 待士以禮. The parallel supports 國士, a man of distinction in the state, without restricting this to a loyal governor. See https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/WUL-bunko11_d0271_%E6%99%8B%E6%9B%B8_18.pdf .

repairs.before: Yao Shao raced back to warn Yao Hong: "Jin is past Xuchang—Yuzhou and Anding are too far to save. Move frontier households into the capital for a hundred thousand veterans.
repairs.after: When Yao Shao heard of the Jin army’s arrival, he returned to Chang’an and told Hong, “Jin has already passed Xuchang. Yuzhou and Anding are isolated and distant and would be hard to relieve in an emergency. Move the garrison households inward to strengthen the capital region. We could raise a hundred thousand picked troops, enough to go anywhere in the realm.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹聞王師之至，還長安，言於泓曰：「晉師已過許昌，豫州、安定孤遠，卒難救衛，宜遷諸鎮戶內實京畿，可得精兵十萬，足以橫行天下。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Chang’an, Shao’s reason for returning, the garrisons’ isolation, and the claim the resulting force could range across the realm.

repairs.before: Liang Xi argued: "Yao Hui terrifies the north; his garrisons hate Bobo and will die before yielding—Bobo cannot skip Anding to strike the core.
repairs.after: Liang Xi, the left vice-director, said, “Yao Hui, Duke of Qi, is brave and has a formidable reputation. The people north of the ridge fear him. The garrison’s people already bear Bobo a deep grudge and should hold out to the death without wavering. Bobo cannot bypass Anding and raid the distant capital region.
repairs.sourceWitness: 其左僕射梁喜曰：「齊公恢雄勇有威名，為嶺北所憚，鎮人已與勃勃深仇，理應守死無貳，勃勃終不能棄安定遠寇京畿。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Liang’s office, Hui’s ducal rank, martial reputation north of the ridge, and the residents’ own hostility and determination.
